raw_sections.summary:
EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Technical Lead and Senior Software Engineer with 9+ years designing and shipping cloud-native platforms, event-driven services, and AI-enabled applications across fintech, media, and enterprise SaaS. Hands-on expertise across the full stack — Python, FastAPI, React/Next.js, PostgreSQL/MySQL/NoSQL, and AWS/GCP/Azure — with production experience integrating payment, KYC, and LLM/agentic services for organizations including Wipro (JioHotstar), Kays Harbor (fintech/BNPL), and Ekvinti. Proven record leading engineering teams of up to 8, owning architecture from design through production, and coordinating delivery with cross-functional and client stakeholders.
raw_sections.skills:
CORE COMPETENCIES
Engineering Leadership & Team Ownership • System Design & Microservices Architecture • Full-Stack Delivery (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, FastAPI) • Cloud-Native Development (AWS, GCP, Azure) • Payment & KYC Integrations • AI/LLM Integration & Automation • CI/CD & Infrastructure as Code • Cross-Functional & Client Stakeholder Coordination
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages & Frameworks: Python, FastAPI, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, GCP, Azure (App Services), Docker, Terraform, Nginx, CI/CD (Bitbucket) Data & Messaging: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis Payments & Identity: Payment gateway integrations, DigiLocker API, virtual KYC flows, Auth0, DriveWealth, Unit API AI & LLM Integrations: OpenAI, Claude, LlamaIndex, ElevenLabs, Hedra, Sarvam AI Architecture & APIs: REST APIs, Microservices, System Design, IBM CPLEX (optimization) Agentic & MCP Tooling: FastMCP (server & API integration), tool-calling agents, Gemini Delivery & Coordination: Agile/Scrum (sprint planning, standups, retrospectives), JIRA, Confluence, cross-team & stakeholder coordination
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Lead | Ekvinti Technologies Pvt Ltd — Mumbai, India Tech Stack: React, Node.js (Express), Python (FastAPI), MySQL, Azure, Docker, Terraform
06/2025 – Present
Architected and led end-to-end development of TrustVid, an AI-powered personalized video generation platform, integrating ElevenLabs, Hedra, Sarvam AI, and WhatsApp APIs into a unified production pipeline.
Led architecture planning and day-to-day technical direction for a team of 6 developers as Technical Lead, translating product requirements into execution plans.
Stepped up to own full architecture and technical direction for the platform following the departure of the prior senior Tech Lead, absorbing broader technical accountability across the team.
Designed a multi-stage rendering architecture (script → audio → video → delivery) using FFmpeg and Remotion, engineering cost- optimized processing for high-volume media generation.
Built a credit-based monetization and usage-tracking system aligned to third-party API consumption, enabling accurate cost attribution and scalable pricing.
Owned Azure cloud infrastructure end-to-end — Terraform-based IaC, Bitbucket CI/CD pipelines, and Azure App Service deployments — establishing repeatable, automated release processes.
Built a Design Agent integrating FastMCP server calls with Gemini to interpret natural-language prompts and translate them into structured JSON architecture updates applied live to editor timeline elements.
Sr. Software Engineer | Wipro Ltd (JioHotstar) — Mumbai, India Tech Stack: Node.js, React, Python (Flask, FastAPI), MongoDB, Docker, on-premises + AWS infrastructure
03/2022 – 06/2025
Led a team of 8 developers within the JioHotstar BPE (Business Process Engineering) wing, owning end-to-end delivery of six enterprise portals — Expense Management, Banquet Booking, Invoice Management, Employee Safety, and Employee Tracking — all built on a Python/React stack with MongoDB as the primary data layer, from architecture through production support.
• Acted as primary technical point of contact for JioHotstar stakeholders and coordinated sprint planning, task allocation, and cross-
team dependencies with the Data Science wing.
• Designed and built an MST Optimization platform pairing a Python/React stack with IBM CPLEX solvers to automate complex
scheduling and resource-allocation decisions.
Containerized all services using Docker and managed hybrid AWS + on-prem infrastructure, optimizing EC2, load balancers, and Nginx configuration for reliability.
Software Engineer | Kays Harbor Technologies Pvt Ltd — Chandigarh, India Tech Stack: React, Node.js, Docker, AWS
06/2021 – 04/2022
Delivered full-stack solutions and architecture for an enterprise fintech client, continuing the same engagement after being retained directly by the client; later promoted for strong performance across two concurrent engagements.
Frontend Lead on Snapmint, a Buy-Now-Pay-Later checkout platform: owned frontend integration of the flash checkout widget embedded on partner merchant sites (including boAt and Firebolt), engineering a single-click render flow that loaded live checkout state, KYC status, and financing terms in one call — with only one attempt to get the production render right.
Developed and containerized Flask-based microservices on AWS powering SavingsOak, an HSA (Health Savings Account) platform; built core integrations with DriveWealth, Unit API, Auth0, and payment gateways, and designed User, Admin, and Employer dashboards on a Next.js frontend.
Automated event-driven workflows using EventBridge, SQS, and Lambda, reducing processing latency by 30%.
Software Engineer | True Tech Professionals Pvt Ltd — Panchkula, India Tech Stack: Node.js, React
03/2021 – 06/2021
Initial contracting entity for the same fintech client engagement continued above; when True Tech Professionals dissolved shortly after the engagement began, was retained directly by the client (Kays Harbor Technologies) for full-time continuation of the same project. Software Engineer | Laitkor Info Solutions Pvt Ltd — Lucknow, India Tech Stack: PHP
05/2020 – 03/2021
Engaged initially on a ~4-month hourly contract basis before transitioning to a full-time position in July 2020.
Architected end-to-end product solutions for non-profit service-management platforms, leading HubSpot and third-party API integrations to extend functionality.
Delivered custom enterprise web applications for non-profit and service-management clients, collaborating cross-functionally to meet delivery timelines and functional requirements.
Team Lead | Path Coders Pvt Ltd — Mohali, India Tech Stack: Python, React
07/2019 – 01/2020
Led team operations and development of JavaScript-based applications (React, Gatsby, Angular), delivering product solutions and REST services.
Gained hands-on experience with AWS Lambda and CloudWatch alongside Python/Flask backend development.
Web Developer | OurDesignz — Mohali, India Tech Stack: PHP, JavaScript, jQuery
08/2017 – 06/2019
Began career as a Software Engineering Intern before converting to a full-time Web Developer role; built a real estate web platform for the Dubai market using CodeIgniter (PHP).
Researched and developed Chrome/Mozilla browser extensions using web-scraping tools (Knime, Octoparse, Selenium, Scrapy) for automated data extraction.
